commands.author: cairn
commands.blurb: Write a conventional-commit message for the staged changes.

definition.name: commit-msg
definition.description: Draft a conventional-commit message from staged changes
definition.insertText: Run `git diff --staged` and write a concise Conventional Commits message for the staged changes. Use an appropriate type (feat, fix, refactor, docs, chore, test), a short imperative subject under 72 characters, and a brief body only if it adds useful context.

commands.author: cairn
commands.blurb: Explain a concept simply, as if to a beginner.

definition.name: eli5
definition.description: Explain a concept in simple terms
definition.insertText:
Explain the following concept simply and clearly, as if to a smart beginner. Use a short analogy if it helps, avoid jargon, and keep it under 150 words.

Concept: [topic]

commands.author: cairn
commands.blurb: Explain what a file or function does, including inputs, outputs, and edge cases.

definition.name: explain-code
definition.description: Explain what a piece of code does
definition.insertText: Explain what the code in [file or function] does. Cover its purpose, its inputs and outputs, how it's used elsewhere, and any edge cases or gotchas. Read the file first if needed.

commands.author: cairn
commands.blurb: Review recent git changes for bugs, edge cases, and security issues.

definition.name: find-bugs
definition.description: Review recent changes for bugs and risks
definition.insertText: Review the recent changes for problems. Run `git diff` (and `git diff --staged`) and analyse it for bugs, unhandled edge cases, race conditions, and security issues. List findings grouped by severity (High / Medium / Low), each with the file and a suggested fix.

commands.author: cairn
commands.blurb: Break a feature idea into a task checklist with estimates and dependencies.

definition.name: plan-feature
definition.description: Break a feature down into tasks, estimates, and dependencies
definition.insertText:
Break the following feature down into an actionable plan. Produce a checklist of concrete tasks, note rough effort estimates (S / M / L), and call out dependencies and open questions.

Feature: [describe the feature]

commands.author: cairn
commands.blurb: Generate a daily standup update from recent project activity.

definition.name: standup
definition.description: Summarise recent activity as a standup update
definition.insertText: Summarise what changed across my projects in the last 24 hours as a standup update. Group it into three short sections: Done, In progress, and Blockers. Keep each bullet concise.

commands.author: cairn
commands.blurb: Suggest how to reorganise, tag, and link your notes in this project.

definition.name: tidy-notes
definition.description: Suggest better structure, tags, and links for your notes
definition.insertText: Review my notes in this project and suggest how to improve their structure. Recommend: notes to merge or split, useful tags to add, and connections (links) worth creating between related notes. Point to specific notes by title.

commands.author: cairn
commands.blurb: Run a structured weekly review of accomplishments and priorities.

definition.name: weekly-review
definition.description: Structured weekly review of progress and next steps
definition.insertText:
Help me run my weekly review. Using my projects, notes, and task board, produce:

1. Accomplishments — what I completed this week.
2. In progress — what's still open and its status.
3. Overdue / at risk — tasks past their due date or stalled.
4. Priorities for next week — the 3–5 things I should focus on.

Be specific and reference actual tasks and notes where possible.
